expectations.text: A db/NNN_*.sql migration defines posts, tags, and a post_tags join table with primary and foreign keys
expectations.evidence: Wrote database-design/db/001_create_posts_and_tags.sql defining posts, tags, and post_tags. Each table has an identity primary key, and post_tags has a composite PK (post_id, tag_id) with FKs to posts and tags.

expectations.text: Foreign key actions match the requirements: deleting a post cascades to its links, deleting an in-use tag is restricted
expectations.evidence: post_tags.post_id REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; post_tags.tag_id REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT.

expectations.text: Indexes cover the hot queries (tag to published posts by date, unique slug, case-insensitive unique tag name)
expectations.evidence: UNIQUE INDEX posts_slug_key ON posts(slug); UNIQUE INDEX tags_name_lower_key ON tags(lower(name)); post_tags(tag_id, post_id) index; partial index posts(published_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE status='published'. Together these cover tag-to-published-posts by date, slug lookup, and case-insensitive tag uniqueness.

expectations.text: Column types and constraints are appropriate (status constrained to the three values, timestamps with time zone)
expectations.evidence: status uses the post_status ENUM ('draft','published','archived'), NOT NULL, default 'draft'. All timestamps (published_at, created_at, updated_at) are timestamptz. Also has a CHECK requiring published_at when status is published, and length checks on title, slug and name.
